Character sprites extracted from
Shiniyuku Kishi, Isekai ni Hibiku Danmatsuma
(死に逝く騎士、異世界に響く断末魔).

The original character sprites are stored as layered image assets and
assembled according to the game's sprite composition data.

This gallery contains all usable character sprite combinations defined
in the game's original sprite table.

从《死に逝く騎士、異世界に響く断末魔》
游戏资源中提取的人物立绘。

本作人物立绘以分层图像素材的形式保存，
并按照游戏中的立绘组合数据进行合成。

本画廊收录游戏原始立绘表中定义的全部可用人物立绘组合。
